Class PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable

public without sharing class PromoteCheckoutToLedgerQueueable
implements Queueable

Queueable job that promotes checkout records to ledger entries for Bill__c records. Uses the CursorIterator pattern to process bills one at a time across multiple queueable executions, allowing for large datasets to be processed without hitting governor limits. Optionally deletes checkout records after successful promotion.

public void execute(QueueableContext context)

Executes the queueable job. Initializes the cursor iterator on first execution, processes one bill per execution by calling BillService.promoteCheckoutToLedger(), and chains to the next queueable if more bills remain.

Parameters:
    context – The QueueableContext provided by the Salesforce platform
